title: Grilled Peruvian Banana Skewers
description: Delicious and easy-to-make banana skewers marinated in Peruvian spices and grilled to perfection.

ingredients.name: Bananas
ingredients.notes: Ripe bananas work best for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Peruvian Warmly Spiced Rub
ingredients.notes: You can adjust the amount of chili powder to your taste.

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: For brushing the skewers during grilling.

instructions: Thread the banana pieces onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together the Peruvian Warmly Spiced Rub and vegetable oil.
Brush the spice mixture onto both sides of the banana pieces.
Let the skewers marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium heat.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until caramelized and slightly charred.
